# Scarpar

> Free, open-source, self-hosted CMS + ecommerce + business-management platform. Next.js 15
> (App Router, TypeScript, React Server Components) + Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Row-Level
> Security) + Tailwind v4. Multi-tenant: one deployment serves many independent organizations, each
> toggling modules and picking a vertical preset (ecommerce, courses, services, real estate).
> MIT licensed. A self-hosted alternative to Shopify, Medusa, and Payload.

Notable: cash-on-delivery + manual bKash/Nagad payment verification, local rider delivery with
courier adapters (Steadfast, Pathao), an 11-block CMS page builder, in-store POS, A4/thermal/label
receipt printing (including Mushak 6.3 VAT invoices for Bangladesh), and Postgres RLS-enforced
multi-tenancy with a six-tier role system.
